facts.summary: Interim analysis missed efficacy threshold; trial and drug development stopped · Phase 2b/3 · Validive in severe oral mucositis · not yet approved
facts.indication: severe oral mucositis in oropharyngeal cancer patients undergoing chemoradiotherapy

evidence.summary: the trial did not meet the pre-defined threshold for efficacy of a 15% absolute difference in SOM prevention between Validive and placebo.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the trial did not meet the pre-defined threshold for efficacy of a 15% absolute difference in SOM prevention between Validive and placebo.
evidence.safety: The DSMB also reported that there were no safety concerns attributed to Validive.
evidence.program_discontinued: Monopar announced today that it will be discontinuing the study along with the active development of Validive.
